content.short: The first open-source music project on Cardano.
content.description: Firebird is a four song album composed by the musician Cullah built on the decentralized Cardano blockchain. Firebird the first open-source album on Cardano. We believe the future of music is open-source, collaborative, and decentralized. We believe in a future where musicians can create together freely and openly while protecting their rights of ownership and ways to monetize their work. That is why we’re building an dApp where Cullah & any artist/musician can interact with their works and recordings in an open and collaborative way.
